Cephalo installation and integration philosophy: Non-destructive, adaptive, and respectful of existing user environments. Always use managed block delimiters (<!-- CEPHALO MANAGED BLOCK START/END -->), timestamped backups, isolated venv options, and non-destructive hook merges. <PERSON> must adapt and integrate, not overwrite or destroy.

UI/UX Aesthetic Constraint: Strictly avoid flashy ASCII loaders and isolated novelty animations in production reader interfaces. Prioritize instant cache hydration, clean typography, grouped settings tabs, uncluttered 3-tab navigation, and mandatory multi-viewport browser screenshot verification (Desktop, Tablet, Mobile) before marking UI complete.

Cephalo distribution and git policy: Background git auto-push and auto-commit are completely removed from daemon loops. When users install or clone Cephalo, they receive an installed cognitive tool, not a project that commits or pushes on their machines. Specialties and memories stay strictly local. Pushes to GitHub (LaptopKing/Cephalo) are manual, deliberate, and only executed during local pair-programming sessions when agreed upon.
